about: The shared fixture of the book's search: the inputs (texts, passages, builds and their questions, a prompt) and the outputs src/schwingnet/rag.py gives for them, filled in by python3 tools/rag.py fixture. tests/schwingnet/test_rag.py holds the package to the outputs and tests/test_rag_tool.py holds the browser's mirror, rag/search.js, to the same, scores compared to the bit.

chunks.text: The sacrum is the anchor the surgeon trusts, and the count runs up the sweep from it.

chunks.title: One
chunks.heading: Counting from the anchor
chunks.text: Counting from the sacrum: each frame overlaps the last by two bodies, and the anchor is counted once. Frames that do not link are declined.

chunks.text: Frames frames frames: a long passage about frames, boxes and matches, which repeats its words so that its length counts against it.

chunks.title: Two
chunks.heading: Studies of classes
chunks.text: Studies of the classes of transitional anatomy: a sixth lumbar body, a sacralised L5, and the counts that disagree.

chunks.title: Two
chunks.heading: The basis of a count
chunks.text: The basis of every count is the anchor; a count from C2 and a count from the sacrum must sum to 22.

chunks.text: Two counts that sum to 22 check each other. Grade: Measured.

chunks.text: The budget is 97 ms a frame on the device in the operating room, measured on a recording.
